meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪多智能体系统全链路操作，生成可追溯证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在构建多智能体系统时，需要记录操作日志并满足审计需求
copy.tagline_en: Track full-chain operations in multi-agent systems and generate traceable evidence chains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build multi-agent systems that need operation logs and audit trails

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会记录系统每次关键操作，按 trace_id 串成可追溯的证据链，并生成向量索引；你可按 trace_id、时间或官署检索这些记录。
howto.when: 由各官署在分发、扫描、解析等关键节点调用，或由事件总线异步推送进入证据链。

say.text: 把这次分发操作记入证据链，trace_id 用 A-123
say.note: 会生成一条含官署、动作、目标与时间戳的事件

say.text: 按 trace_id A-123 查完整执行链
say.note: 返回串联好的证据链，可追溯每步操作

say.text: 检索最近一小时所有官署的操作日志
say.note: 返回时间窗内事件，支撑审计与回放

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude records every key operation, building a traceable evidence chain by trace_id and a vector index; you can query by trace_id, time window, or department.
howto.when_en: Triggered when departments call at key nodes like dispatch, scanning, parsing, or via event bus async push into the evidence chain.

say_en.text: Record this dispatch operation into the evidence chain with trace_id A-123
say_en.note: Creates an event with actor, action, target, and timestamp

say_en.text: Query the full execution chain for trace_id A-123
say_en.note: Returns the linked evidence chain for traceability

say_en.text: Retrieve operation logs for all departments in the last hour
say_en.note: Returns events within the time window for audit and replay
